title: ChatGPT Next Web
descript: ChatGPT Next Web is a cross-platform chat UI for OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini and other model providers. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container; API keys and chat history are kept in the browser, so no server-side database is required.
important: Open the web UI, then set your API endpoint and key in Settings (they are stored in your browser). No server-side data is written; the mounted data folder only exists for platform compliance. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

cmd: if [ -n "$PROXY_URL" ]; then     export HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0";     protocol=$(echo $PROXY_URL | cut -d: -f1);     host=$(echo $PROXY_URL | cut -d/ -f3 | cut -d: -f1);     port=$(echo $PROXY_URL | cut -d: -f3);     conf=/etc/proxychains.conf;     echo "strict_chain" > $conf;     echo "proxy_dns" >> $conf;     echo "remote_dns_subnet 224" >> $conf;     echo "tcp_read_time_out 15000" >> $conf;     echo "tcp_connect_time_out 8000" >> $conf;     echo "localnet 127.0.0.0/255.0.0.0" >> $conf;     echo "localnet ::1/128" >> $conf;     echo "[ProxyList]" >> $conf;     echo "$protocol $host $port" >> $conf;     cat /etc/proxychains.conf;     proxychains -f $conf node server.js;     else     node server.js;     fi

github.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.

zh-cn.descript: ChatGPT 风格的多模型聊天前端，需自备 API Key。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/chatgptnextwebdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
